email.subject: Fast Lane Co: missing calls and bookings
email.body:
Hi Luis,

I looked at Fast Lane Co's website. Two things are likely costing you customers: there's no click-to-call button, so mobile visitors can't tap to ring you and probably just move to the next shop. And there's no online booking, so anyone wanting to schedule service after hours has no way to do it and leaves.

I fix these kinds of issues for local businesses for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and what I'd change? No obligation either way.

Alex
